note: args.canvas makes the picture the call draws on, w x h, uint8 RGB: with only "flat", that colour everywhere; with "mul" and "add", pixel i (counted row by row from the top left) has the channels (mul[c] * i + add[c]) % 256, and if "rows" [ya, yb] is there too only rows ya to yb - 1 are woven like that and the rest is "flat". "out" is the picture after the call. left and right are the fighter dicts: a key that is absent was not passed (hp_max 100, trail none, level 1, max_level 3, status "", status_k 0, flash 0, ko and win false, t 0); floats are float.hex() strings, trail null is trail=None. The keywords named in "call" were passed (x0, x1, y1 default to the safe box, alpha 1, ink INK, bar_h 6, center "VS", abilities); abilities is [left rows, right rows] of dicts with tag, name, state, glow, sweep (absent: tag "", state "locked", glow 0, sweep none). expect.returns is the dict fight_hud returned (top, bars, and rows when abilities were given); expect.noted what it appended to reelkit.ui.DRAWN. Cases with "state" are made by hand (the plan's list first, then thresholds and edges); cases with source "kit.picture" are the arguments kit.picture.render passed at that frame of the example episode; the rest are seeded.
